title: Precedence and Associativity
learningObjectives: Explain precedence and associativity in C++.
Identify the operators, operands and result types involved.
Predict an expression's result by tracing it.
Use the topic in a focused program.
Avoid common mistakes and choose a clear alternative.

understand.concept: Precedence and associativity determine expression grouping, not evaluation order. Parentheses make intent explicit and improve readability.
understand.whyItMatters: Accurate expression understanding prevents logic errors and improves safety, readability and maintainability.
understand.explain: Study precedence and associativity through the rule summary and examples; trace values carefully and note type and edge-case constraints.
